query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN s.billing_interval = $1 THEN $2
    WHEN s.billing_interval = $3 THEN $4
  END AS plan,
  COUNT(*) AS current_paid_subscribers
FROM subscriptions s
WHERE s.status = $5
  AND s.plan = $6
  AND s.billing_interval IN ($7, $8)
  AND s.provider IN ($9, $10)
  AND s.bound_to_user_id IS NULL
  AND s.bound_to_household_id IS NULL
  AND (
    s.trial_start IS NULL
    OR s.trial_end <= now()
  )
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 limit $11
